answer: Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 10 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the summit. Promotion is logged in shale and onyx recomputes the tiers from replay. A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, which means a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. A 231 account operation therefore ties up 13 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
